title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ryoushu no Youjo

thread.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke • Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen - Ryushu no Youjo - Episode 17 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode’s humor and found the character interactions entertaining.
Some viewers appreciated the inclusion of side-character and family material, even when it was brief.
The episode was generally considered enjoyable, but some felt it was relatively basic and light on substance.
One recurring criticism was visibly reused footage and stiff animation, though another commenter viewed the repetition as part of the comedy.
